attchmntText: Apollo Sindoori Hotels Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Apollo Sindoori Hotels Limited approved its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. Statutory auditors M/s P. Chandrasekar LLP issued a limited review report. For the half-year ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was 20,284.02 lakh rupees, up 35.42 percent from 16,539.85 lakh rupees in the previous year. Profit before tax stood at 1,142.23 lakh rupees, compared to 905.48 lakh rupees previously. Net profit was 849.39 lakh rupees, versus 649.84 lakh rupees. The board noted an NSE non-compliance email regarding directorship of Mr. Pottipati Vijayakumar Reddy. Mr. Michael Ebenezer was appointed as Chief Operating Officer. Public shareholding remains at 35.32 percent.
